Tool: Jasper (Jasper AI)
Supports Services: Service 3 – AI Content Creation & Copywriting Category: Automation / Search
Primary Use:
• It generates high-volume, brand-consistent marketing copy across blogs, ads, and emails by training on a company’s specific style samples.

• The platform ensures large teams maintain a single "Brand Voice" across 30+ languages, preventing the generic feel typical of standard AI tools.
Notes:
• Pro plan starts at $59/month; includes templates for AIDA and PAS frameworks.
